findings.title: OSS FR/EN/AR locale rotation not implemented
findings.summary: Mission task #5 asks 'Check FR/EN/AR rotation if implemented'. Audit confirms NO rotation logic in OrderStatusScreenComponent.vue or PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue. OSS displays exclusively the current admin/store locale (FR). For a customer wall display in a multilingual context (Cayenne French Guiana), a rotation toggle (e.g. swap headers every 8s FR→EN→AR) would improve customer comprehension. Deferred V1.0.2 backlog candidate — not a V1 blocker since OSS still works in FR and the FR-only customer base is the primary V1 target (Le Cayenne, French Guiana).

findings.title: Cash Overview reconciliation panel uses 'à venir' placeholder for variance input
findings.summary: Réconciliation caisse panel says 'Pour calculer l'écart, saisir le comptage physique du tiroir (à venir).' The actual variance input lives in POS reconcile flow (CashDrawerSessionController::reconcile endpoint), confirmed working via direct service test. The cash-overview surface offers READ-ONLY visibility — physical-count input not yet wired in this admin tab. Owner Q14 (Wave Polish Final) likely already noted this. Functional: full close/reconcile flow works through POS UI; cash-overview is observability-only.

findings.title: Vue SPA router triggers 3-redirect ping-pong during E2E automation (STAFF_ONLY + auth gate + kiosk auto-lock)
findings.summary: Repeated /admin/cash-overview and /admin/order-status-screen navigations bounce through /kiosk/idle or /login mid-flight, requiring 2-3 retries to land. Root cause: combination of STAFF_ONLY_MODE redirect + auth-status race + kiosk auto-lock. Not a user-impact defect (real cashier sessions stay stable), but degrades E2E automation reliability — automated probes hit phantom 401/redirects. Recommend stabilizing the gate priority order OR exposing a Playwright-friendly bypass cookie for E2E suites.
